== Profile ==
Some Japanese-only text here: 恐竜型デジモン。

A dinosaur Digimon that evolved from Agumon. Its head is covered in a hard shell and it breathes fire.

== Attacks ==
* '''Mega Flame''' (Mega Furēmu): Spits a ball of fire.
* '''Great Antler''': Charges with its horns.
